{{Top|leg}}
An '''urpine''' was a [[Diet/Legends|carnivore]] native to [[Revyia]]. Some were kept by [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] communities to ward off herds of herbivores that attacked the [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-like Revwiens.
